<h2>Run sjSDM Tuning Candidates for One Fold</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Prepares one fold once, then fits, predicts, and scores every regularization
candidate while preserving failures as compact status rows.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>run_sjsdm_tuning_fold_candidates(
  data_candidates = NULL,
  list_fold_context = NULL,
  prepare_fold_function = NULL,
  fit_function = NULL,
  predict_function = NULL,
  score_function = score_sjsdm_tuning_predictions,
  seed = 900723L,
  epsilon = 1e-06,
  retain_prediction_cache = FALSE
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="data_candidates">data_candidates</code></td>
<td>
<p>Candidate table returned by [build_sjsdm_regularization_candidates()].</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="list_fold_context">list_fold_context</code></td>
<td>
<p>Fold metadata returned by [build_sjsdm_tuning_fold_context()].</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="prepare_fold_function">prepare_fold_function</code>, <code id="fit_function">fit_function</code>, <code id="predict_function">predict_function</code>, <code id="score_function">score_function</code></td>
<td>
<p>Injectable fold preparation, fit, prediction, and scoring functions
documented by
[run_sjsdm_tuning_candidates()].</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="seed">seed</code></td>
<td>
<p>Non-negative base integer used to derive candidate fit and score seeds.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="epsilon">epsilon</code></td>
<td>
<p>Probability clipping tolerance passed to
[score_sjsdm_tuning_predictions()].</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="retain_prediction_cache">retain_prediction_cache</code></td>
<td>
<p>Logical. When true, return compact prepared-fold metadata and candidate
probability matrices alongside the unchanged tuning table.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>Compact candidate-by-fold tuning table with metrics and structured status.
When 'retain_prediction_cache' is true, returns a named list containing that
table and a compact fold prediction cache without fitted model objects.
</p>
